Individual instruction (1-on-1) significantly more expensive. Berlitz Total Immersion: 60 lessons over 5 days (12 lessons/day). Berlitz is also an official test center for telc, TOEFL, and Cambridge exams.
berlitz_cologne.notes: Berlitz Cologne is an authorized exam center for multiple certifications (telc, TOEFL iBT, Cambridge). They can both prep you AND administer the exam, but Cambridge B2 First exam administration at Berlitz Cologne is not confirmed on their site – they list it as a certified partner but exam dates must be confirmed. Expensive compared to VHS and Englisches Institut.

duolingo_accepted: Duolingo English Test (DET) is NOT accepted by University of Cologne (Uni Köln) or TH Köln for standard admission to English-taught programs. DET is accepted at approximately 50 programs in Germany, mostly private universities (IU Internationale Hochschule, Constructor University, GISMA Business School, Munich Business School, Bard College Berlin, Berlin School of Business and Innovation, University of Europe for Applied Sciences, Technische Universität Berlin – some programs). There is unconfirmed information suggesting University of Cologne 'might' accept DET score 105+, but this is NOT listed on official Uni Köln admission pages. For public universities (Uni Köln, TH Köln), stick to IELTS, TOEFL iBT, or Cambridge B2 First. DET is fast (results in 2 days) and cheap (~$59 USD) but carries recognition risk in Germany.
fastest_path:
Fastest path from zero certificate to valid certificate for German university admission in Cologne region:

PHASE 1 – Assess current level (Day 1-2):
- Take free Cambridge online level test (cambridgeenglish.org/de/test-your-english) or VHS placement test
- If already B2: skip to Phase 3
- If A2/B1: need intensive preparation (Phase 2)

PHASE 2 – Intensive preparation (4-12 weeks depending on starting level):
- BEST: Englisches Institut Köln intensive crash course or ongoing B2 course (€159-297/month) + self-study
- ALTERNATIVE: VHS B2 course + Cambridge prep materials (free from Cambridge website)
- SELF-STUDY: Cambridge free preparation materials + practice tests + Grammar in Use + online platforms (GlobalExam, IELTS Liz, BBC Learning English)
- If starting from zero (A0): NOT possible in 1 month; need 6-12 months minimum to reach B2

PHASE 3 – Choose and book exam (Week 1-2 of final month):
- FASTEST: IELTS computer-based at British Council Köln – €276, results in 3-5 working days, multiple test dates per month, book online instantly
- ALTERNATIVE: Cambridge B2 First digital at Englisches Institut Köln – €275, results in 5-10 working days, need to book by deadline
- SLOWEST: TOEFL iBT – must travel to Düsseldorf/Dortmund (~34-70km), $280 USD (~€260), results in 4-8 days

PHASE 4 – Receive certificate and apply:
- IELTS: 3-5 days after exam
- Cambridge B2 First: 5-10 working days after exam (digital)
- TOEFL iBT: 4-8 days

FASTEST TOTAL TIMELINE (from B2 level):
1. Book IELTS computer-based at British Council Köln: ~1 week to secure slot
2. Take exam: 1 day
3. Receive results: 3-5 working days
4. Total: ~2 weeks from booking to valid certificate

FASTEST FROM ZERO (absolute beginner):
- Not possible in 1 month. Realistic minimum: 3-6 months intensive study to reach B2, then 2 weeks for IELTS. Total: ~3-6.5 months.

RECOMMENDED FAST TRACK (if at B1/B2 level):
1. Take free level test today
2. Book IELTS computer-based at British Council Köln for 2-3 weeks from now
3. Use those 2-3 weeks for intensive self-study with free Cambridge/IELTS materials + practice tests
4. Take exam, get results in 3-5 days
5. Submit certificate with university application
Total: ~4 weeks from today to valid certificate (if already B1/B2 level)
refugee_discounts:
Refugee discounts for English language exams and courses in NRW are limited and mostly apply to German language (not English):

1. BAMF Integration Courses (Deutsch für Zuwanderer): Free or heavily subsidized for recognized refugees, asylum seekers, and tolerated persons. Covers German up to B1, NOT English. Administered through VHS. Contact BAMF or local Ausländerbehörde for eligibility.

2. Bildungsgutschein (Agentur für Arbeit / Arbeitsagentur): 100% funding for eligible unemployed or soon-to-be-unemployed individuals. Covers approved AZAV-certified courses including English at providers like ILS (100% förderungsfähig for their Cambridge FCE Fernkurs), some Berlitz courses (AVGS training voucher eligible for individual English instruction A2-C1). Must be referred by Agentur für Arbeit. Not specifically for refugees but refugees with employment status may qualify.

3. VHS course fees: Standard VHS English courses are already relatively affordable (~€120-180 for a course). No specific refugee discount for English courses found at VHS Köln. Some VHS locations offer reduced fees for those with 'Bildungsurlaub' status or low-income concessions.

4. University refugee programs (German language only): TH Köln offers German preparatory courses for refugees (German C1 with DSH exam); TU Dortmund, Uni Siegen, HS Niederrhein, HAWK offer free/subsidized German courses for refugees aiming for university entrance. These are for German language, NOT English.

5. Cambridge exam fees: No refugee discount for Cambridge B2 First exam fees. Standard fee €275 at Englisches Institut Köln; €259 via VHS NRW. School project discount (€211) only for school students.

6. IELTS: No refugee discount; standard €276.

7. Practical advice: If you have refugee status and receive benefits (BAföG, Bürgergeld, etc.), check with your case worker whether language courses for university admission can be covered as part of integration or education support. The Agentur für Arbeit 'Bildungsgutschein' is the most likely funding route for English courses if you're registered as jobseeking.
self_study_1month_realistic:
Self-study for B2 certificate in 1 month from ZERO is NOT realistic.

Realistic assessment by starting level:
- From ZERO (A0/A1): Absolutely not possible in 1 month. CEFR B2 requires 500-600 guided learning hours from scratch. 1 month at 4h/day = 120 hours → maybe A2.
- From A2: Not realistic for B2 in 1 month. Need ~200-300 hours to reach B2 from A2. 1 month intensive (4h/day = 120h) → B1.
- From B1: Possible to solidify B1 and progress toward B2 with intensive study (120h in 1 month), but passing a B2 exam requires exam-specific preparation. Might be borderline.
- From solid B2: 1 month of focused exam prep (practice tests, format training) IS realistic to pass B2 First or IELTS.

For university admission (B2 required):
- If you already have B1/B2 level: 1 month self-study + exam is feasible, especially with IELTS (computer-based, fast results).
- If you're below B1: Need minimum 2-3 months intensive study before attempting any B2-level exam.

Best self-study resources:
- Cambridge free preparation materials (cambridgeenglish.org/de/learning-english/exam-preparation/)
- IELTS Liz (ieltsliz.com) – free IELTS prep
- BBC Learning English (bbc.co.uk/learningenglish)
- GlobalExam (global-exam.com) – 유료 but has free trial
- English Grammar in Use (Raymond Murphy) – intermediate/upper-intermediate
- British Council LearnEnglish (learnenglish.britishcouncil.org)
- YouTube: Englisches Institut Köln, Cambridge English channel

Self-study can work for reaching B2 from B1 in 2-3 months with daily 3-4h study. For exam-specific prep, 1 month is realistic if you already have the language level.
recommendation:
RECOMMENDATION: IELTS computer-based at British Council / Englisches Institut Köln.

WHY IELTS is the best choice for your situation:
1. FASTEST: Results in 3-5 working days (vs. 5-10 for Cambridge digital, 4-8 for TOEFL)
2. MOST ACCESSIBLE: Test center in Cologne city (Gertrudenstr. 24-28), no travel needed
3. BEST ACCEPTANCE: Accepted by Uni Köln (IELTS 5.5 = B2) and TH Köln (IELTS 6.0 for most CS-related programs). More widely accepted than DET and more flexible than Cambridge.
4. BOOKING SPEED: Multiple test dates per month, book online instantly, no registration deadlines like Cambridge
5. PREPARATION: Abundant free self-study materials online (IELTS Liz, British Council, YouTube)
6. COST: €276 – similar to Cambridge €275, cheaper than TOEFL ($280 USD ~ €260)

WHEN TO CHOOSE CAMBRIDGE B2 FIRST INSTEAD:
- If the specific university program explicitly requires 'Cambridge B2 First' (some do)
- If you want a lifelong certificate (IELTS expires after 2 years, Cambridge is valid for life, though universities may require recent results)
- If you're already enrolled in a Cambridge prep course (e.g., at Englisches Institut Köln)
- If you want recognition beyond university (employer recognition of Cambridge is strong in Europe)

WHEN TO CHOOSE TOEFL iBT:
- If your target program specifically requires TOEFL (check program page)
- If you're already in the US system / comfortable with American English
- NOT recommended for Cologne region: no local test center, must travel to Düsseldorf/Dortmund

WHEN TO CONSIDER DUOLINGO:
- NOT recommended for Uni Köln / TH Köln: not accepted
- Only if applying to private German universities (IU, Constructor, etc.) that accept DET

EXAM ORDER OF PREFERENCE FOR COLOGNE REGION UNIVERSITY ADMISSION:
1. IELTS computer-based (British Council Köln) – fastest, in-city, best acceptance
2. Cambridge B2 First digital (Englisches Institut Köln) – same location, similar cost, lifelong certificate
3. TOEFL iBT (Düsseldorf) – travel required, more expensive
4. Duolingo DET – NOT accepted by public universities in Cologne

TOTAL ESTIMATED BUDGET (IELTS path):
- IELTS exam: €276
- Self-study materials: €0 (free online) to €50 (books/practice tests)
- Optional prep course (Englisches Institut, 1 month): €159-297
- TOTAL (exam only, self-study): ~€276-326
- TOTAL (exam + prep course): ~€435-573

action_plan.action: Take a free English level assessment today
action_plan.details: Use Cambridge English free online test (cambridgeenglish.org/de/test-your-english) or VHS placement test (sprachtest.de). Determine if you are A2, B1, B2, or above.

action_plan.action: Check your target university program's exact English requirements
action_plan.details: Go to the specific program page at Uni Köln (studieninteressierte.uni-koeln.de) or TH Köln (th-koeln.de/en/academics/programs) and check the 'How to Apply' section for exact English certificate requirements. Note the minimum IELTS/TOEFL/Cambridge scores.

action_plan.action: If at B1/B2 level: book IELTS computer-based at British Council Köln
action_plan.details: Go to ieltsregistration.britishcouncil.org, select Germany > Köln, choose a date 3-4 weeks from now. Pay €276. This gives you 3-4 weeks to prepare intensively.

action_plan.action: If below B1: enroll in an intensive English course immediately
action_plan.details: Options: Englisches Institut Köln (ongoing B2 course from €159/month, entry anytime); VHS Köln (English B2 standard course); ILS distance learning (if you prefer self-paced). Target: reach B2 within 2-3 months, then take IELTS.
action_plan.timing: Enroll this week; exam in 2-3 months

action_plan.action: Prepare for IELTS using free + low-cost resources (3-4 weeks)
action_plan.details: Free: IELTS Liz (ieltsliz.com), British Council LearnEnglish, Cambridge IELTS practice tests (free samples). Paid: Cambridge IELTS practice test books (~€30), IELTS Official Practice (£), GlobalExam (subscription). Focus on: listening (British accents), reading (academic texts), writing (Task 1 + Task 2), speaking (practice with partner/tutor).

Bring valid passport/ID. Arrive on time. Computer-based test: Listening, Reading, Writing on computer in one session (~2h 45min). Speaking test scheduled separately (same day or within a few days) – one-on-one with examiner.

action_plan.action: Receive results and submit to university
action_plan.details: IELTS computer-based results: 3-5 working days via SMS/email. Download Test Report Form (TRF). Submit with university application via uni-assist or directly. Copy of TRF is usually accepted; keep original safe.

action_plan.action: If IELTS score is below required minimum: consider retake or Cambridge B2 First
action_plan.details: If you scored e.g., IELTS 5.0 but need 5.5 or 6.0: book another IELTS (can retake anytime) OR switch to Cambridge B2 First (register at Englisches Institut Köln, more 준비 time available). Alternatively: check if the university offers a 'probationary' English test or interview (TH Köln International Business offers faculty interview if no certificate at enrollment time).

If you have refugee status or receive Bürgergeld/BAföG: inquire at Agentur für Arbeit about Bildungsgutschein for English courses. Check with your case worker (Sozialamt, Jobcenter) if language exam costs can be covered as part of integration support. For ILS distance learning: 100% förderungsfähig with Bildungsgutschein.

action_plan.action: Alternative: If you prefer a lifelong certificate or the program requires Cambridge
action_plan.details: Register for B2 First digital at Englisches Institut Köln (€275, register by deadline). Attend their prep course (€159/month ongoing) or self-study using Cambridge free materials. Digital exam: results in 5-10 working days. Next available dates: 01 Oct, 05 Nov, 21 Nov, 05 Dec, 18 Dec 2026.
